title: elwendia cabulica
intro: Elwendia cabulica, commonly known as Babbula or Ghajak, is a medicinal plant native to the Indian subcontinent. It has been traditionally used to treat various health issues due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Elwendia cabulica include reducing fever, relieving pain and inflammation, and treating respiratory and gastrointestinal issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
